1 Section S1: Variance Partitioning Model Diagnostics

To transform the data for the Variance Component Analysis, we compared three approaches: Raw Counts, Log transformation (log1p), and Square-Root transformation (sqrt).

Model Structure: variable ~ 1 + (1 | year_fac / plant_id)

1.1 S1.1 Heterospecific Pollen (HP)

Selection: The raw data (Left) shows severe heteroscedasticity. Both comparisons suggest stabilization, but Square-Root was chosen for alignment with standard count data practices.

1.2 S1.2 Conspecific Pollen (CP)

Selection: CP loads are generally higher than HP but also exhibit skew. Transformations improve normality. The same Square-Root transformation is applied for consistency.

1.3 S1.3 Proportion HP (HP / Total)

Selection: Proportions are bounded [0,1]. While Binomial/Beta models are theoretically superior, for the purpose of VCA (partitioning variance), the Square-Root transformation provides a reasonable approximation of normality for the residuals.

2 Section S2: Model Selection for CP-HP Relationship

To determine the functional form of the relationship between Conspecific (CP) and Heterospecific (HP) pollen deposition, we compared Linear (Type 1) and Exponential (Type 3) models using Akaike Information Criterion (AIC).

Data Aggregation: We aggregated pollen counts to the plant level (mean per plant) to account for multiple stigmas sampled from the same individual.

Model Selection Criteria: If the Exponential model provided a significantly better fit ($> 2) compared to the Linear model, it was selected. Otherwise, the simpler Linear model was preferred.

3 Section S3: Diagnostic Plots for Slope Comparison Model

To validate the use of the square-root transformation for the “Slope Showdown” analysis (aggregated plant-level data), we examined the residual diagnostics of the linear model.

Model: lm(sqrt(mean_HP) ~ mean_CP * as.factor(year), data = aggregated_data)

10 Section S4: Data Descriptions

10.1 Overview

This document provides metadata, variable dictionaries, and summary statistics for the datasets associated with the manuscript. These datasets are archived for reproducibility and public access.

10.2 Data Description

These datasets contain empirical data collected to investigate the mechanisms linking pollinator visitation networks to stigmatic pollen deposition on Succisa pratensis. The study investigates how community-level network structure (specialization, interaction evenness) and single-visit pollen deposition stochastics scale to population-level pollination outcomes across three years (2022-2024).

The provided files are: - pollen_deposition.csv: Total pollen loads on stigmas collected from the field. - SVD.csv: Single-visit deposition experimental data. - network_metrics.csv: Aggregated yearly metrics constructed from three primary data sources: 1. Plant-pollinator visitation networks: Used to calculate network-level specialization (\(H_2'\)) and species-level specialization/interaction evenness for Succisa pratensis using the bipartite R package. 2. Stigmatic pollen deposition: Used to calculate the linear slope of Conspecific (CP) vs. Heterospecific (HP) pollen accumulation, and mean HP loads. 3. Floral abundance transects: Used to calculate the mean Succisa pratensis abundance per plot and total community floral abundance. - interaction_data_all_22_24.csv: Full plant-pollinator visitation observation data for the entire community across all years. - interaction_data_Succisa_22_24.csv: Subset of the visitation data containing only observations for Succisa pratensis. - plant_abundance_22_24.csv: Floral abundance transect data for all plots across years. - pollen_load_and_guts_2024_Succisa_pratensis.csv: Raw pollen load and gut content data for individual pollinators.

10.3 1. Pollen Deposition Dataset (pollen_deposition.csv)

This dataset contains information regarding pollen deposition on individual stigmas of Succisa pratensis over three consecutive years.

10.3.1 Data Dictionary

Variables in Pollen Deposition Dataset
variable label
id Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)
year Year of sampling (2022-2024)
plant_id Unique plant/patch identifier
conspecific_pollen Count of conspecific (Succisa) pollen grains on stigma
heterospecific_pollen Count of heterospecific (non-Succisa) pollen grains on stigma
pollen_total Total pollen count on stigma

10.4 2. Single Visit Deposition (SVD) Dataset (SVD.csv)

This dataset contains experimental observations of pollen deposition resulting from a single, uninterrupted visit by various pollinator morphogroups to virgin Succisa pratensis inflorescences.

10.4.1 Data Dictionary

Variables in SVD Dataset
variable label
id Unique sample identifier (Stigma ID)
year Year of observation
morphogroup Functional group of the visitor (e.g., Eristalis spp.)
species Taxonomic species of the pollinator
duration_sec Duration of the single visit (seconds)
conspecific_pollen Conspecific pollen deposited during single visit
heterospecific_pollen Heterospecific pollen deposited during single visit

10.5 3. Network Metrics Dataset (network_metrics.csv)

This dataset aggregates plot-level and community-level metrics calculated from plant-pollinator interaction networks, floral abundance surveys, and overall stigmatic pollen loads.

Slope Slope (Beta) of the CP-HP relationship (Type 1 dynamics)
Mean_HP Mean Heterospecific Pollen per stigma
Succisa_Abundance Mean abundance of Succisa pratensis per plot
Total_Abundance Total floral abundance in the community
